fr_saoul_adj.why: English sound-alike painted in musee/taverne (Oct 31 2026 Musée fix pack; room moved to rue_commercante/taverne in batch 7, painting kept): a tipsy rosy-cheeked old fisherman dozing with his nose dipped in a bowl of soup. After the party he was too intoxicated to drive, so he took a taxi.

fr_ivrogne_adj.why: English sound-alike painted in musee/taverne (Oct 31 2026 Musée fix pack; room moved to rue_commercante/taverne in batch 7, painting kept): a red-nosed old ship's cook peeling a sack of onions with tears streaming down his face. Moved from the wall-text room R_text_medical (where it was only a blank plaque) into this painted room. Gate 29 connotation note (insulting). Example English kept free of blocked words (gate 6). Gloss shown as "habitual heavy drinker; given to heavy drinking" so that the painted card stays free of blocked words (gate 6); vocab gloss unchanged.
fr_ivrogne_adj.note: Someone who drinks too much alcohol; insulting when said about a person, so use it with care.
ex: Dans la chanson, un vieux marin ivrogne chante faux.
In the song, an old sailor who drinks too much sings out of tune.
fr_ivrogne_adj.en: habitual heavy drinker; given to heavy drinking
